newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland's new Euro-Lot airline to fly abroad.
newsitem.headline: Poland's new Euro-Lot airline to fly abroad.

text.p: Euro-Lot, a soon-to-be-formed unit of Poland's state-owned national airline PLL LOT SA, plans to fly some international flights in addition to taking over LOT's domestic business, PAP news agency said on Sunday.
Eurolot, which is due to begin operations in April, will use LOT's turbo-propeller ATR-72 planes for international flights to Minsk, Lvov, Kiev, Copenhagen and Vienna.
Euro-Lot, which is currently awaiting the necessary aviation certificates, earlier said it would likely start operating with eight or nine 19-seat Canadian-made Jet-Stream-31 planes.
PAP said that by September the airline would also add several 30- to 37-seat planes.
The number of LOT passengers on domestic flights increased by 15.5 percent to 311,000 last year, but the domestic service was still loss-making.
